title: Compact mailbox wake text: ids, sequence, unread count and sender only, protocol taught once
outcome: Phoenix::Fable report 17 (Engram pilot, relayed by Engram::Advisor 2026-09-06): roughly 40 wakes in one day each repeated about 600 characters of protocol instructions (list -> read after processedThrough -> process -> CAS acknowledge, CLI fallback with TERMAL_CLI/TERMAL_SESSION_ID/TERMAL_BASE_URL). This is reported context overhead per turn, not measured token accounting. Desired: the routine wake carries only mailbox id, latest sequence, unread count and latest sender (plus topic), and the protocol lives once in persistent instructions or a help/prime surface (the coordination CLI teaching in tm-1b9a is the natural home). Wake text must stay metadata-only and free of imperative prose (tm-uwx.5). Acceptance: a wake fits in a few lines; a test pins the wake body; the protocol text is reachable from the tool description or bd prime/AGENTS guidance rather than repeated per wake.
disposal_reason: Backlog triage w-930e4d333f07 (Architect1 batch 1a, spot-checked by Termal::Fable2): CLOSE-DONE. The compact wake text landed in d786dfa (ancestor of master f7db2c58). Closed by evidence.
